integrity: All universal conclusions are justified by the written analytic phase-lift argument; finite numerical diagnostics supplement, but do not replace, the proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem covers finite Blaschke products with all zeros on one fixed ray and at least one zero away from the origin; it does not cover arbitrary zero arrays or unequal target spacings. The paraorthogonal interpretation uses established optimal-prediction facts. Exact historical priority is not independently established.
title: Parity-sharp phase locking of extreme angular gaps in aligned Blaschke fibres
